description: U.S. Solar Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage Cost Benchmarks: Q1 2021 is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Vignesh Ramasamy, David Feldman (National Laboratory of the Rockies). NREL has been modeling U.S. solar photovoltaic (PV) system costs since 2009. This year, our report benchmarks costs of U.S. PV for residential, commercial, and utility-scale systems, with and without storage, built in the first quarter of 2021 (Q1 2021). Coverage: the United States. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1 files.. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only.
